extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern “GREAT Protector Active” is a personal accident plan offering “personal accident coverage of up to S$4.5 million” for “total and permanent disability, or loss of use of limbs or sight due to an accident.” The document describes a lump-sum disability payout and also a “Benefit Booster” feature that can increase the payout by “up to 150%” for certain accident scenarios (e.g., when the Life Assured is a pedestrian/cyclist/passenger in road accidents or on public conveyance as a passenger), with exclusions such as “PMDs do not qualify.” The product offers plan options by sum assured: Basic (S$200,000), Classic (S$500,000), and Elite (S$1,000,000), with correspondingly higher “Disability” amounts listed in the table. Optional add-ons include the Lifestyle Rider (reimbursements for TCM up to S$1,000 per accident; scar removal up to S$1,000 per accident; dental up to S$700 per lifetime) and the Recovery Cash Rider (weekly income up to S$200, up to 104 weeks per accident). A key limitation noted is eligibility for “increased-risk activities” and the insurer’s “absolute discretion” on eligibility.
quality_notes: The document text has missing/blank product name placeholders near the illustration (likely plan/rider names removed during conversion), but the overall product name is identifiable from the file name and the content.

The table headings for some disability payout sub-benefits (labelled B and C) are not explicitly explained in the extracted text; amounts are present but benefit meaning is only partially supported by narrative.
No underwriting, waiting/free-look days, renewal, or comprehensive exclusion list is explicitly provided.

policies.quick_summary: Personal accident plan with up to S$4.5 million coverage for total & permanent disability or loss of use of limbs or sight due to an accident, optional Benefit Booster (up to 150% in specified scenarios), and optional Lifestyle and Recovery Cash riders for selected accident-related expenses and temporary inability to work (weekly income). Plans (Basic/Classic/Elite) are shown by disability sum assured options (S$200,000 / S$500,000 / S$1,000,000). Increased-risk activities like rock climbing and scuba diving may be eligible but depend on conditions and insurer discretion for claim eligibility.
policies.target_customer: Singapore Citizens, Permanent Residents (PRs) and holders of Employment Pass aged between 17 and 65; Juveniles aged between 1 and 16 and holders of S Pass, Dependant’s Pass or Student’s Pass may purchase only the Basic Plan
coverage_scope: Personal accident coverage (up to stated limits) for total and permanent disability or loss of use of limbs or sight due to an accident
Optional Lifestyle Rider reimbursements for eligible post-accident recovery treatments
Optional Recovery Cash Rider weekly income during temporary inability to work/domestic duties/attend school
policies.residency_requirements: If life assured resides outside Singapore for more than 183 days, overseas Benefit Booster is payable only if the accident occurs outside the life assured’s residing country and issuing country (Singapore).
policies.eligibility_notes: Singapore Citizens/PRs/Employment Pass: ages 17–65 may purchase any plan (Basic, Classic, Elite). Juveniles 1–16 and holders of S Pass/Dependant’s Pass/Student’s Pass may purchase only the Basic Plan. Benefit Booster applies in specified scenarios and accidents outside of Singapore; PMD accidents do not qualify. Recovery Cash Rider covers a Life Assured from age 17 Age Next Birthday regardless of employment status and occupation class.
important_caveats: Increased-risk activities (e.g., rock climbing and scuba diving) are covered only when undertaken on a leisure basis with or under the management of a licensed organisation/establishment and when every safety precaution has been followed; the company has “absolute discretion” to determine eligibility for claim.
Recovery Cash Rider reimburses weekly income and is subject to a limit: “maximum of one claim event per lifetime under this benefit,” after which the benefit terminates.
Benefit Booster: up to 150% increase applies only to specified road/public conveyance outside-Singapore scenarios and “Accidents involving Personal Mobility Devices (“PMDs”) do not qualify.”
Overseas Benefit Booster eligibility depends on residing country vs issuing country (Singapore) if the life assured resides outside Singapore for more than 183 days.

source_evidence.quote: personal accident coverage of up to S$4.5 million
Enjoy one of the highest personal accident coverages of up to S$4.5 million in the event of total and permanent disability, or loss of use of limbs or sight due to an accident.

With the Lifestyle Rider, you can receive reimbursements for expenses on post-accident recovery
treatments such as Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), scar removal and dental work .

The optional Recovery Cash Rider covers a Life Assured from 17 Age Next Birthday regardless of the employment status and
occupation class.
Singapore Citizens, Permanent Residents (PRs) and holders of Employment Pass who are aged between 17 and 65, may purchase any plan (Basic, Classic, Elite) under this policy.

review_notes: Disability table includes additional rows labelled B and C (“Payout of up to”), but the document does not clearly define what those rows correspond to beyond “Please refer to the Tables of Disability Payout in Sections B, and C, respectively, of the policy contract.”
Increased-risk activities eligibility is described with “absolute discretion” by the company, but no exhaustive list of eligible sports/conditions is provided.
